items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: The interviewer notes 'Gallodoro' and 'Al Galadora' in the context of the interviewee discussing Hale Byers, but the interviewee does not mention Gallodoro directly or describe a personal interaction.

ctx.x: Well, you know, I was so interested and I wanted to develop this. I wanted to develop an orchestra because well, the bigger orchestras that I listened to, the Whiteman orchestra, the Ray Miller orchestra, they all had two saxophones. the Whiteman at that time had two saxophones and a fellow by the name of Byers, Hale Byers, you know, the guy who played everything.

items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: I knew Bill from New York.

ctx.x: Of course we had Bill Challis, Bill was with Whiteman then of course.
That’s right. I knew Bill from New York.
